vetSays.line: 🛡️ Heidi, Kurt, Kaloki and Elodie met them at the door — 4 put down. Heidi, Kurt, Kaloki, Elodie are hurt.
🛡️ Heidi, Blanca and Kurt met them at the door — 3 put down. Heidi, Blanca, Kurt are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Heidi, Blanca, Kurt, Kaloki and Xavier met them at the door — 5 put down. Heidi, Blanca, Kurt, Kaloki, Xavier are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kaloki just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Blanca just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Blanca, Kurt, Kaloki and Sari met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Blanca, Kurt, Kaloki, Sari are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sandra just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sandra met them at the door — 1 put down. Sandra is hurt.
🛡️ Duc met them at the door — 1 put down. Duc is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Quinn was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Duc taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Quinn showed Xavier the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Fireside lesson: Duc passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Soonthorn just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zhandos just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Zhandos met them at the door — 1 put down. Zhandos is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
